name: MCPorter
description: Calls any MCP server from the terminal or TypeScript: lists and calls tools, handles OAuth, and generates standalone CLIs and typed clients.

skills.name: List Servers
skills.description: Lists configured MCP servers and their tools with TypeScript-style signatures, importing configs from Cursor, Claude, and Codex.

skills.name: Call Tool
skills.description: Calls an MCP tool or reads a resource from the command line with colon flags or function-call syntax, with stable JSON output.

skills.name: Generate CLI
skills.description: Generates a standalone, ready-to-run CLI for any MCP server, with embedded schemas and optional bundling into one binary.

skills.name: Emit Typed Client
skills.description: Emits TypeScript .d.ts interfaces or a typed client so agents and tests call MCP tools like normal functions.

skills.name: OAuth Sign-In
skills.description: Signs in to hosted MCP servers that need a browser login with mcporter auth, then caches and refreshes the OAuth tokens.
